Combat units specialize in acquiring more material for conversion, facility defense or personal protection.

Renders and commissioned works from the creator IBEX-CG: https://twitter.com/IBEXCEO

Contains the following units:
-SLAVESOLDIER: Conscripted combatants that serve a period of 3 years before remanufacture
-CUNTCOMMANDER: Officer-Class combatant used to organize and lead squads of combat units
-CAPTURECUNT: Combat unit primarily tasked with Material Acquisition
-SHOTOSHINOBI: CQC specialist combatant with access to previously encountered Martial art techniques
-ASSAULTAMAZON: Berserker with anti-Matter Maul
-WICKEDWITCH: Mage drone comprised of controlled Magic-Compatible Material with access to previously acquired magical abilities

UPDATED March 2026
Pictures will have most recently uploaded pieces first and then previous pieces sorted into groups by drone type.

These collections could not be made without the assistance of https://x.com/Esmeral00117055 who takes the time to collect all drones produced and categorize them.
